lane.instructions: Choose a pursuit target from `pots`. A pot with positive catchable_bugs has an estimated interception opportunity; a pot with zero has none. Do not stay at a zero-catch pot when another pot has an estimated catch. Move toward an opportunity even before ready_to_drop. Choose hold only when `bugs` is empty, or scan when visible bugs have no estimated catch. These estimates are uncertain; code verifies fresh alignment before dropping.
